subject: Avoid re-evaluation of unchanged conductors during Shiny.unbindAll() and Shiny.bindAll()

messages.author: 85435c7e2689700c
messages.subject: Avoid re-evaluation of unchanged conductors during Shiny.unbindAll() and Shiny.bindAll()
parts:
Hi

I'm using the Shiny.unbindAll() and Shiny.bindAll() functions to create dialogboxes with new inputs and outputs, and it works mostly fine. There is one problem though, which is that every time I unbind and binds the current output values gets send again. This is a problem for me at least as I use a custom output to send data to the client that gets added to a local data model, and don't want the same data to get added several times. I could of course add some sort of unique identifier to the data and examine that client-side to determine whether to proceed with the data, but it seems to me that this shouldn't be necessary just in order to have a dynamic GUI.

Is there a rationale for this behaviour of unbindAll/bindAll or is it an unanticipated side effect?

Thanks for your responses in advance

best

Thomas
